Cam: Quick flag from the compact-list playtest: the overflow menu (three dots) sits flush against the row edge and it's hard to hit when multi-select checkboxes are enabled. Missed actions in 3/5 sessions.
Rina: Thanks — which page and density?
Cam: Jobs table, compact density, checkboxes visible. Icon visually looks fine but clickable rect is tiny (~18px).
Omar: Could we add an invisible hitpad token that expands the interactive area without changing visual layout? e.g. `--hitpad-edge-action: 6px` and use padding so icon remains 20px but target becomes ~32px.
Kai: Agree. For touch we still want 44px but desktop 32px is reasonable. Implementation idea: `.edge-action { width:20px; height:20px; padding: var(--hitpad-edge-action); box-sizing: content-box; }` keeps the layout intact.
Cam: Also toasts triggered by these actions are being positioned under the sticky filter bar on this page and briefly obscure the controls. They currently show terse copy like "Done". Propose consistent phrasing: `"<Verb> <object> \u2014 Undo"` (e.g., "Archived 1 job \u2014 Undo") and anchor toasts to the page frame bottom-right for dense lists.
Rina: Do we have a per-page toast anchor token? I don't think so. Maybe add `--toast-anchor-bottom` and allow `.page-toasts` container inside `.page-frame { position: relative; }`.
Omar: Implementation sketch: `/* page frame */ .page-frame { position: relative; } .page-toasts { position: absolute; right: 24px; bottom: var(--toast-anchor-bottom, 24px); }` That keeps toasts from sliding under sticky headers. Also use `role="status" aria-live="polite"` for SR announcement.
Kai: Accessibility: edge action must be a proper `<button>` with `aria-haspopup="menu"` and SR label: "Actions for <row title>". If menu is portalled, manage focus return. Menu items should be sentence case and verb-first: "Archive job", "Duplicate job".
Cam: Keyboard flow: Tab into row -> arrow to cell -> Tab to action -> Enter opens menu -> Arrow keys navigate -> Enter to pick -> focus returns to action. If we portal, we must capture the opener element to return focus on close.
Rina: UX/visual: prefer a subtle ghost background on hover and a 2px focus ring color token for compact mode. No permanent primary icon (adds clutter). Show primary only on hover or when row actions >1.
Omar: I'll prepare a tiny tokens PR: `tokens/interaction: add hitpad-edge-action=6px` and a spacer token for toast offset `tokens/space: add toast-anchor-bottom-small=20px`.
ui-preview-bot: Preview built: https://preview.redwood/ui/compact-edge-action (branch: feat/hitpad-toast-anchor).
Kai: I'll add accessibility notes and SR copy to the Figma page and update the accessible components checklist.
Cam: Can we do 6 quick hallway sessions to validate discoverability and toast overlap? If all good we ship the token + toast container option this sprint.
Rina: Scheduling now. Also add a Storybook story for compact table with sticky filters to test toast layering and keyboard flow.
Cam: Thanks all 44d. Let's keep changes minimal and roll out as an opt-in token so other pages are unaffected.
